phases.estimated_duration: 8.50 person-days; 3.33 elapsed days with three independent implementers

tasks.title: Define Entity, Boundary, and Modeling-Round Contracts
tasks.description: Specify minimal shared references, applicability, versions, and validation ownership.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Contract and valid/invalid fixtures define scoped identities, explicit boundary types, source-backed validation, and round outcomes without renumbering IDs.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Schema/reference checks and documented compatibility review pass.

tasks.title: Build Boundary-Scoped Use-Case Models and Scripts
tasks.description: Implement usecase-generatemodel for actor interactions at all identified boundary levels.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every use case has a linked detailed script with boundary/actor references across a three-level example including non-software boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Model/script coverage, stable-ID revision, and invalid-input tests pass.

risk_factors.risk: Use cases restricted to leaf software systems

tasks.title: Build Software-Boundary UI Models
tasks.description: Implement ui-generatemodel preserving existing entry aggregation and screen traceability.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: UI entries resolve to software boundaries and scoped entities; non-software or software-without-UI cases do not create screens.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: UI schema compatibility, applicability, unknown-type, and revision tests pass.

risk_factors.mitigation: Preserve existing IDs/fields and singular screen references

tasks.title: Build Shared Model-Alignment Validation
tasks.description: Implement model-validatealignment with deterministic source-backed checks and clarification.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Entity/boundary conflicts, stale or invalid input, unknown UI typing, and source/manifest disagreement never produce alignment success.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Positive and negative deterministic validator tests pass with item-level evidence.

risk_factors.mitigation: Check actual source artifact definitions and versions

tasks.title: Wire Existing Model Producers and UI Consumers
tasks.description: Connect shared references and validation into existing modeling, prototype, initialization, and change surfaces.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All model artifacts validate together, six screen skills preserve behavior, and affected changes invalidate reports.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Producer/consumer integration tests and existing prototype regressions pass.

risk_factors.mitigation: Preserve established contracts and run regression suite

tasks.title: Integrate S5 Membership and Modeling-Round Lifecycle
tasks.description: Update orchestration/routing/categories and persistent round validation without cyclic DAGs or ID changes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: S11 category is removed but skill IDs retained; current validation is required across round revision/resume and mode/archetype combinations.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Catalog, routing, DAG, applicability, and non-bypassable round tests pass.

risk_factors.risk: Legacy states or solo/rapid bypass produce false completion
risk_factors.mitigation: Preserve IDs and enforce fresh non-bypassable alignment evidence

tasks.title: Verify End-to-End Alignment and Publish Handoff
tasks.description: Prove all requirements with multi-level worked examples, negative scenarios, and actual prototype interactions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 11/11 requirements have passing evidence and actual navigation/dialog verification complements static tests.
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Focused tests, worked workflow, browser/manual walkthrough, and release guide are complete.

risk_factors.risk: Static checks mistaken for runtime verification
risk_factors.mitigation: Observe cross-page navigation and dialog behavior

dependency_graph.note: Parallel implementation uses shared fixtures; runtime model-generation prerequisites are separate. Solo schedule serializes all work.
